name: ma1_lpc_per_tick_mc_sensitivity
description: MA-1 (AC-1): math_engine.run_monte_carlo's current_symphony_return sum (math_engine.py:1162-1166) excludes any holding whose last_percent_change is None/missing. This fixture pins that a REAL, materially different last_percent_change on an otherwise-identical holdings/historical_data/seed input produces a DIFFERENT mc_prob output -- the sensitivity the audit's lead probe demonstrated (lpc swings of a few percent moved mc_prob from ~10 to ~97 on the audit's own holdings). We do not hardcode the audit's exact numbers (different holdings/history here) -- the test asserts the INEQUALITY property (scenario_low != scenario_high), never a literal expected mc_prob.

lpc_low.description: Holding down sharply vs prior close.

lpc_high.description: Same ticker/allocation/history/seed; only last_percent_change differs (up sharply vs prior close).

derivation: 45 raw alternating days -> eligible_days = 45 - (MC_VOL_WINDOW_DAYS - 1) = 45 - 19 = 26 >= MC_MIN_HISTORY_DAYS (20) -- a real (non-sentinel) mc_prob is returned for both scenarios. No mc_prob value is pinned here; the test computes both scenarios live via math_engine.run_monte_carlo and asserts they differ. This is the direct-math-layer half of AC-1 -- the build_replay_day wiring half is covered by ma1_build_replay_day_lpc_stamping.json.
